note: Synthetic26 mode adds an actual PLOUGH writer and moving collision readback centre at a nominal 26 m/s along a bounded back-and-forth path. It is a D2 data-path stress test, not D3 gameplay. Maximum speed is seeded once; subsequent movement/writers use the live game. Diagnostic player health is raised to keep the workload running. Per-frame fine compute sums require every expected timestamped pass. Collision/coarse costs are excluded from fineGpuMs. Human feel and sustained 1440p/60 are not assessed.
